title: About DBPD
key_finding: The City says DBPD is the law-enforcement agency for Daytona Beach and describes a staffed department of roughly 400 people including approximately 250 full-time officers.

title: Police Department
key_finding: The City maintains an active Daytona Beach Police Department page with department contact information and current operations.

title: CompStat
key_finding: DBPD says it uses a computerized database to map criminal activity, detect patterns, and identify hot spots in real time.
